main_text.head: AUTOSCHEDIASMA M. RUDOLPHI GOCLENII liberalium artium Professoris in inclyta Academia Marpurgensi, in Syntagma, seu Synopsin ingenuarum artium, singulari studio & opera à doctrina & virtute praestanti viro, IOHANN. BILSTENIO, Oreadum alumno, concinnatam.
AD STUDIOSOS.

p.i: Confectum,ducente Deo, comitante labore, Illustris Methodi percelebrisq; via, Bilstenii Syntagma breve,atq; rotunda Synopsis, Doctrina ingenua fertile prodit opus.
Non factum doctis, quibus experientia rerum est, Hoc feret aetati commoda magna rudi.
Lac pueris aptum: solidus cibus aptus adultis, Ventriculi haud omnes, omnia ferre queunt.
Quid? quod & hic aliquid, quod discat gradior aetas, Inveniet: docta non sumus arte pares: Dicitur ipse Solon etiam tali ore locutus: Discenti assidue multa senecta venit.
Hoc opus ergo legens, pubes studiosa perennes, Authori grates officiosa refer.
Dilige doctrinam, docilis discendaq; disce, Defuge desidiam, dilige dona Dei. Dona Dei lingua, famula rationis, & artes Bilstenii hic labor est, his sine dulce nihil.

page.notes: Printed "Aliud" at bottom right is a catchword for the next page. Verse spelling follows the print; long s rendered as s. Orthographic peculiarities such as "Authori" and "Lac pueris aptum: solidus" are as printed in the scan; the scan is slightly soft in places but readable.
